import runpy
import sympy as s
n=runpy.run_path('research/primitive-gate-search-pass133.py')
a,b,v,u=[n[k] for k in ('a','b','v','u')]
frame=[u,b+a*u,-a-b**3/s.Integer(2)+v*u,v+s.Rational(3,2)*b**2*a+s.Rational(3,2)*b*a**2*u+a**3*u**2/s.Integer(2)]
for label, target in [('primitive_normal_form',frame),('quadratic_bad_shear',frame[:3]+[frame[3]+frame[1]**2+2*frame[0]*frame[2]+3*frame[1]+5])]:
    status,data=n['probe']([n['polynomial'](f) for f in target])
    assert status=='both_gates_pass', (label,status,data)
    assert s.expand(s.sympify(data['invariant'])-a)==0, data
    print(label,status,data)
assert n['solve_span']([a,b],a*b) is None
print('inconsistent_exact_span_rejected')
